atlas_fit.current_problem: Atlas needs flexible local OCR options for images and PDFs without sending protected documents to cloud services.
atlas_fit.future_risk: Vision-language OCR can hallucinate text, mishandle complex layouts, and expose documents through misconfigured model endpoints.

claims.claim: The repository documents a Python and Streamlit OCR package using Ollama vision models for image and PDF extraction with several output formats and batch processing.
The selected vision models provide accurate OCR for every document type.

excluded_classes: raw financial, legal, tax, insurance, mortgage, estate, brokerage, or account evidence

unresolved: Runtime behavior, security effectiveness, performance, and compatibility were not independently executed or benchmarked in this Mission.
